title: Az Új Gazdasági Mechanizmus és a maszekok (New Economic Mechanism & the Second Economy)
grammar: Tacit Compromises, Economic Modality & Macroeconomic Retrospective in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when the New Economic Mechanism began and what it changed.
I can explain what the háztáji gazdaság and the maszek were.
I can say in the past tense what the reforms made possible.
I can describe in a few sentences how the second economy helped families.
